Sandaconda

Ground

Galar · Generation 8

Sandaconda is a Ground-type Sand Snake Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 3.8 m tall and weighs 65.5 kg. It evolves from Silicobra. Its highest base stat is Defense (125), with a base stat total of 510.
